$meta.name: SkinKey
$meta.direction: Clay & Ink, with four grafts from Deep Teal
grafts: Provenance 'Where this comes from' ledger set like a dispensing label: small-caps keys SKIN / PRODUCT / LIMITS, a 1dp ink rule on top and hairline rows (component.provenanceLedger)
Verdict tint confined to the verdict HEAD; reasons sit on the plain screen surface (component.verdictCard.body has no tint)
Band meters drawn in neutral ink, never the accent (semantic meter.*)
Pharmacist-at-counter icon for the medicine gate; the mortar and pestle is retired (icon.verdict.medicine)
$meta.units: All sizes are dp (React Native density-independent px). CSS output converts 1dp = 1px. letterSpacing is in dp, as React Native expects; CSS output also gives em.

aliasSyntax.{color.text}: semantic colour in the active mode (semantic.color.<mode>.<path>)

tuningHistory: Started from clay-ink.tokens.json values (86 pairs, all passing) and applied the judge fixes before gating.

text-muted light #655B4D -> #564D41 (sand.700) so a real third level fits: text-subtle #6B6152 still reaches 4.77:1 on bg-sunken. Dark text-subtle sand.450 #9E9282 reaches 5.01:1 on surface-raised (and 4.68:1 as disabled-fg on the sand.850 disabled fill).
border-strong unified to sand.500 #807464 in both modes (lowest: 3.35:1 on dark surface-raised; 3.58:1 on light bg-sunken).

Dark accent #B0C5C7 (read as disabled) -> ink.300 #86A4A7 with ink.950 #0C171A text, 6.84:1. Dark accent-pressed ink.400 redefined #5E8286 -> #6B8C90 so the label still reaches 5.01:1. Dark focus ring moved to ink.200 so it stays visible around the deepened button.

Verdict borders raised from decorative hairlines (#3F5534 / #5E4920 in dark, about 1.4:1) to the 500 step of each hue, gated at 3:1 against bg and surface in both modes. Fixes the dark CAUTION edge that disappeared.
Verdict icons get their own 600 (light) / 400 (dark) step: CAUTION icon #8A5D12 is 4.65:1 on its tint, above the Deep Teal fix target #95620F (4.22:1 here).
Meter filled moved from chip-fg to sand.800 / sand.150 (neutral ink); empty stays a full-opacity border-strong outline.

Checker first run: 228 pairs, 0 contrast failures, 2 lint failures (both rule false-positives: HSL saturation overstated near-white sand; the mortar-and-pestle test matched the 'no mortar' note). Rules corrected; negative test with six planted defects caught all six.
$meta.sourceOfTruth: This file. theme.ts and tokens.css are generated by build-tokens.mjs; check-contrast.mjs gates every pair. Do not hand-edit the outputs.

sand.$description: Warm paper neutrals. Half steps (25, 150, 450, 850, 925, 975) exist because the light and dark surface stacks need finer tone steps than a plain 11-step ramp gives.

ink.$description: The single accent: deep blue-green printing ink. Used for buttons, links, focus and selection only. Never a verdict, never a meter.

moss.$description: FITS. Muted moss green, kept well away from the ink accent's hue.

ochre.$description: CAUTION. Ochre or turmeric, hue 35 to 45 degrees. Never red, never an alarm.

slate.$description: UNKNOWN. Cool neutral slate; not an error colour.

$notes.border: Decorative hairline (dividers, card edges). Never the only edge of a control; not gated under WCAG 1.4.11.
$notes.border-strong: Edges that carry meaning: outlined buttons, inputs, empty meter segments, sheet handle. Gated at 3:1 on every surface.
$notes.text-subtle: Third text level (timestamps, helper text). Still gated at 4.5:1 on every surface it can sit on, so it is never 'too faint to read'.
$notes.accent: Light: near-black ink #1B2F32. Dark: deepened to ink.300 #86A4A7 with ink.950 #0C171A text (6.84:1), replacing the washed-out #B0C5C7 that judges read as disabled.
$notes.accent-pressed: Moves toward the background, like a Material 3 state layer: lighter ink in light mode, darker ink in dark mode. Still >=4.5:1 with on-accent.
$notes.focus-ring: 2dp outline, 2dp offset, drawn over bg (so gated against surfaces, not the button fill). Dark uses ink.200 so the ring stays visible around the ink.300 button.
$notes.verdict: bg/fg/border/icon apply to the verdict HEAD only. Reasons always sit on the plain screen surface. Border is gated at 3:1 against bg and surface in both modes (fixes the dark CAUTION edge that disappeared).
$notes.verdict.medicine: Neutral paper and ink, 1.5dp ink outline, pharmacist icon, no verdict label. Not an alarm.
$notes.meter: Neutral ink only, never accent. Empty segments are a full-opacity 1dp border-strong outline (>=3:1).
$notes.overlay-camera: Dims the live camera around the capture oval and barcode window. Gated for on-overlay text over a worst-case white frame.
$notes.qr: QR is always black modules on a white field in both modes, for scanner reliability.
$notes.error: SkinKey has no red. Errors are neutral: icon + text + 2dp text-colour field border. CAUTION is never an error colour.

serif.name: Newsreader
serif.role: Reading content: display, titles, reasons, product names, forecast figures

sans.name: Commissioner
sans.role: Controls, labels, verdict label, body, fine print

title.use: Product title on /check (plain text + Edit link), screen titles, consent privacy sentence

headline.use: Card heads, 'Where this comes from', sheet titles, empty-state titles

reason.use: Reason reading line. Larger than the verdict label (P1). 18 not 20, so reason 02 clears the sticky bar.

verdictLabel.use: FITS / CAUTION / UNKNOWN, with a 24dp icon. Never truncates; wraps at max font scale.

body.use: Body copy, verdict subtitle (one unit, one style), the product fact in each reason (full text colour)

bodyStrong.use: Band value (High), emphasised step, list row title

bodySm.use: Ledger values, supporting lines, card secondary text

label.use: Chip and band names, field labels, snackbar action

overline.use: Ledger keys SKIN / PRODUCT / LIMITS, section eyebrows

caption.use: Destination lines, disclosures, meter labels (Low / Med / High), timestamps

fine.use: Data credits only (Open-Meteo CC BY 4.0, Open Beauty Facts ODbL). The floor: nothing in SkinKey is smaller than 12.

rules.numerals: Dates, prices, SPF, countdowns and reason indices use tabular figures (RN fontVariant ['tabular-nums'], CSS font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).
rules.android: includeFontPadding: false; textAlignVertical: 'center' on single-line labels. Do not set fontWeight on custom families in React Native: the weight is baked into the family key (Newsreader_500Medium). Check Commissioner tracking on a real Android device.
rules.fontScaling: allowFontScaling stays on. Layouts reflow at the largest system font size; buttons stack vertically; verdict labels and reasons never truncate (no numberOfLines on them). maxFontSizeMultiplier 2.0 on body and reason; 1.6 on bottom-nav labels only.
rules.serifUse: Serif for reading content; sans for controls and fine print. Never serif below 18dp.

$usage.lg: cards, verdict head, ledger, QR card

elevation.$approach: Tone first. Light mode: paper stack (bg-sunken < bg < surface < surface-raised) plus one soft clay-tinted shadow, never pure black. Dark mode: tone steps and hairlines only, no shadows.

1.use: Cards on bg: profile card, product match, forecast, share teaching

2.use: Sticky action bar, bottom nav (shadow casts upward)

3.use: Sheets and snackbars get a border-strong edge instead of a shadow

motion.$personality: Ink settling: unhurried, decelerating, no springs, no overshoot, nothing loops.

linear.use: QR countdown rule and determinate progress only

patterns.press: bg to state.pressed (or accent-pressed) in {duration.press}; optional scale 0.98 as a transform only, so layout never shifts. Android: ripple in state.ripple.
patterns.verdictReveal: opacity 0 to 1 and scale 0.98 to 1 over {duration.verdictReveal}, ease decelerate. One light haptic tick when the verdict lands; no extra haptic on CAUTION.
patterns.reasons: opacity 0 to 1 and translateY 6dp to 0, {duration.reasonStagger} stagger, max 3 items
patterns.processingStep: Each tick draws once in {duration.stepTick}. The current step is a static filled ring; no spinner loop.
patterns.sheet: translateY from 100% with {ease.decelerate}, scrim fades in over {duration.state}

reducedMotion.rule: Every transition becomes an opacity crossfade of {duration.crossfade}. No translate, no scale, no stagger. Step ticks appear without drawing. Countdown digits change without animating. Grain is always static.

touch.$rule: Every tappable element has a hit area of at least 48 x 48dp. Visual elements smaller than 48 (32dp chips, 24dp icons, inline 'Feels wrong? Edit') get hitSlop or padding to reach 48. Includes 'Edit' links and the product-title Edit.

icon.library: lucide-react-native (web: lucide) at 1.75 stroke; custom SVGs drawn on the same 24dp grid and stroke

fits.meaning: Scalloped seal with a check. The only non-circular verdict silhouette.

caution.meaning: Partly fits. Never a triangle, never an exclamation mark.

unknown.meaning: Incomplete information. Not an error glyph.

medicine.lucide: custom: head and shoulders behind a counter line, 1.75 stroke
medicine.meaning: Ask the pharmacist. No cross, no pill, no mortar and pestle, no alert.

grain.tile: assets/texture/grain-160.png (static 160 x 160 PNG, not an SVG filter, never animated)
forbidden: behind body text, reasons or ledger rows

zIndex.$rn: On Android, elevation also orders siblings; set elevation alongside zIndex for sheets and snackbars.

destructiveNeutral.$rule: Delete, Revoke. No red: a strong ink outline plus a verb label and an icon, always followed by a confirmation step.

textLink.$rule: Standalone links get a 48dp hit area. Inline links inside a paragraph keep the line height but get hitSlop.

nameOnly.$rule: Uses the FITS or CAUTION head colours with a dashed border and the qualifier 'based on product name only'.

body.$rule: Reasons sit on the plain screen surface. The verdict tint never extends past the head, and CAUTION never fills the screen.

bandChip.$rule: /profile lays bands out as a 2 x 2 grid of tiles. The band is always written in words; the meter only repeats it.
bandChip.name: {type.label}

tag.$rule: Static tags are not tappable. A tappable chip is 32dp visual with hitSlop to 48.

skinMap.$rule: Photo-free zone diagram traced from YouCam masks. No photo, no skin colour.
skinMap.label: {type.caption}

provenanceLedger.$rule: Set like a dispensing label: 1dp ink rule on top, small-caps keys, hairline rows, no tinted box. Below 380dp width the key sits above the value so 'Measured by YouCam Skin Analysis, 1 Nov' stays on one line.
provenanceLedger.title: {type.headline}
provenanceLedger.caption: {type.caption}

consentSheet.actions: Start scan (button.primary) and Not now (button.destructiveNeutral outline, same 52dp height) so both carry equal visual weight; stacked full width.

deletedStep.label: {type.bodyStrong}
deletedStep.caption: {type.caption}
deletedStep.$rule: 'Deleting photo from YouCam' is its own visible step with a tick and a timestamp; announced through a live region.

storeLinkOut.label: {type.button}
storeLinkOut.$rule: Two lines: 'Find better matches' then 'Opens a Flipkart search, filtered to Oily Skin'. Text-only store names, no logos.

copy: Ranked by fit to your skin. No paid placements.
We may earn a commission; it never changes the ranking.

tryOnCompare.$rule: 'Preview, not a shade guarantee' sits below the image on the plain surface, never over the photo, and is always visible.

stateView.$rule: Empty, error and offline states. Neutral, never red. Offline actions are disabled, not hidden.
stateView.title: {type.headline}
